title: Python in a batch job
story: `round_means.py` uses pandas to average pLDDT per design round. Run it on scores.csv as a Slurm batch job (it needs no GPU), wait for it to finish, and report round 2's mean from the log.

files.~/{{project}}/round_means.py:
"""Average pLDDT per design round, with pandas."""
import sys
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
print(df.groupby("round")["plddt"].mean().round(1).to_string())

tasks.text: Submit round_means.py on scores.csv as a batch job
Type round 2's mean pLDDT from the job's log

hints: pandas comes with anaconda, so load it first (the job inherits it). sbatch --wrap="python round_means.py scores.csv" runs one command as a job; its output lands in slurm-JOBID.out.
